integrity_notes: Symbolic derivation, polynomial sign certificates, and independent numerical Lindblad checks are reproducible from the embedded standalone checker. A relevant 2004 topology study was assessed from its abstract only; priority requires independent scrutiny. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Single-excitation nearest-neighbor path of three sites with equal hopping J=1; linear energy detuning, uniform Markovian local dephasing, one endpoint sink, no independent competing loss and fixed site-1 preparation. The result concerns mean first absorption time, not stationary injected transport or transport on arbitrary networks.
title: A sharp dephasing-assisted transport threshold for a linearly detuned three-site chain
